title: ChronOps integration snapshot, version 3
description: What ChronOps GET /integration/snapshot returns to integrations: the caller's projects, their budget and their tasks, as ChronOps sees them. A change to this shape bumps version.

reportAt.description: The moment the budget figures are computed for, the end of the last ChronOps report.

workerLinked.description: Whether the token's user is linked to a ChronOps worker. Without the link, myHours is null on every task; assignedToMe is known either way, since ChronOps assigns by email.

code.description: The ChronOps project code, stable across renames.

client.description: The names of the project's Clients, A to Z, joined with ", ". Null when the project has no Client with a known name.

complete.description: Whether ChronOps marks the project complete. Null when ChronOps cannot tell.

tasks.description: Every task of the project, including the ones not assigned to the caller.

mode.description: The period the cap and the consumed figures cover.

capHours.description: Hours allowed for the period. Null when the project has no cap, or no figures for the current period.

maxBudget.description: Money allowed for the period, when ChronOps knows it.

consumedHours.description: Hours consumed in the period, at reportAt.

spentBudget.description: Money spent in the period, at reportAt, when ChronOps knows it.

remainingHours.description: capHours minus consumedHours, negative when over. Null when capHours is null.

status.description: ChronOps' own health colour. Unconfigured when capHours is null.

estimateHours.description: Workday's estimate, which every import replaces.

budgetHours.description: The budget a lead set on the task (ADR-0047), one number for every assignee. Null without one: a consumer that shows budget hours then falls back to estimateHours when it is over 0, as ADR-0047 does.

workedHours.description: Workday's hours on the task, every worker and all time, as of reportAt, without the adjustment. Workday rows carry no sign check, so it may be negative.

workedHoursAdjustment.description: Hours a lead added to workedHours (ADR-0047), negative when removed, 0 without one. The task's worked hours are workedHours plus this.

assignedToMe.description: Whether ChronOps assigns the task to the token's user, by email. Known with or without a worker link.

myHours.description: The caller's hours on the task in the current month, summed over the workers linked to the login. Null when not assigned or not linked.
